_meta.about: Retail chains, jewellers, payments, small finance banks, NBFCs, insurers and market infrastructure. Leaders checked against web reports in Oct 2026 where search allowed; others marked not re-checked.
_meta.review: All entries unreviewed until the founder approves them.

companies.name: Lulu Group India

parts.SELLS: Lulu Group India runs LuLu shopping malls and LuLu Hypermarkets in cities such as Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Bengaluru, Lucknow and Hyderabad. The hypermarkets sell groceries, fresh food, electronics and fashion to families who come for a big weekly shop.
parts.EARNS: It earns in two ways: a retail margin on everything sold in its hypermarkets and LuLu Fashion stores, and rent from the brands, cinemas and food courts that lease space in its malls. The malls give it steady rental income alongside the thinner grocery margins.
parts.SIZE: One of the largest mall developers and hypermarket operators in India, especially strong in Kerala. Its parent, the Abu Dhabi based Lulu Group, is one of the biggest retailers in the Gulf.
parts.RIVALS: In malls it competes with Phoenix Mills, Nexus Malls and DLF's retail properties. Its hypermarkets compete with Reliance Smart, DMart, Spar and Star Bazaar.
parts.WATCH: Lulu has announced new malls and hypermarkets across several Indian states, including food-processing and logistics hubs to supply them. Watch how quickly these open outside its Kerala base.

quiz.prompt: What does Lulu Group India run besides hypermarkets?
Where does Lulu earn steady rental income?
Which mall developer is a rival to Lulu in India?

companies.note_30w: Lulu Group India runs large LuLu malls and hypermarkets, earning retail margins plus mall rents. Strong in Kerala, it is expanding to more Indian cities.

companies.name: Spencer's Retail

parts.SELLS: Spencer's Retail runs supermarkets and hypermarkets under the Spencer's and Nature's Basket names, selling groceries, fresh food, gourmet products and home goods. It is part of the RP-Sanjiv Goenka Group and has its strongest presence in eastern India.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin on what it sells. Food and groceries bring most of the sales, while gourmet foods, private labels and non-food items earn better margins. Online orders add to store sales.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized supermarket chain and one of the older names in organised Indian grocery retail, much smaller than the national leaders. Its network has shrunk in recent years as it exited weaker markets.
parts.RIVALS: DMart, Reliance Smart, More, Star Bazaar and Spar in stores; Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and BigBasket online. Local kirana stores remain a big rival for everyday grocery shopping.
parts.WATCH: The company has been closing weaker stores and focusing on its core regions to cut losses. Anuj Singh was re-appointed MD & CEO in 2026. Watch whether the smaller network turns profitable.

quiz.prompt: Which gourmet grocery brand belongs to Spencer's Retail?
Which business group owns Spencer's Retail?
Which listed chain is a store rival to Spencer's?

companies.note_30w: Spencer's Retail, an RP-Sanjiv Goenka company, runs supermarkets and Nature's Basket gourmet stores, mainly in eastern India, and is shrinking to its core to cut losses.

companies.name: More Retail

parts.SELLS: More Retail runs More supermarkets and larger More hypermarkets selling groceries, fresh produce, staples and household goods. It was founded by the Aditya Birla Group and has been owned since 2019 by a consortium of Samara Capital and Amazon.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin on everything it sells, with private-label staples and fresh food helping margins. It also supplies groceries for Amazon Fresh in many cities, which adds online volume to its stores.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger supermarket chains, with hundreds of stores across the country, though well behind the biggest players. Its stores are spread across several states, with a strong base in south India.
parts.RIVALS: DMart, Reliance Smart, Spencer's, Star Bazaar and Spar in stores; Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart and BigBasket online. Neighbourhood kirana stores also compete for daily grocery spending.
parts.WATCH: More Retail has said it is preparing for a public listing. Watch its store profitability, its tie-up with Amazon Fresh, and how it copes with quick-commerce apps.

quiz.prompt: Who owns More Retail today?
Which online grocery service does More supply in many cities?
Which group originally founded More?

companies.note_30w: More Retail runs More supermarkets and hypermarkets, owned by Samara Capital and Amazon. It supplies Amazon Fresh and is preparing for a public listing.

companies.name: V-Mart Retail

parts.SELLS: V-Mart runs value fashion stores selling affordable clothing, footwear and household goods to families in smaller towns, mainly in north and east India. It also owns Unlimited, a value fashion chain in south India, and runs the LimeRoad online marketplace.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin on clothes and goods, most of it from apparel, with much of the range made under its own labels. Festival and wedding seasons bring the busiest sales.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading value fashion retailers focused on tier-two and tier-three towns, with hundreds of stores. Most of its stores are in Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and nearby states, where organised fashion retail is still young.
parts.RIVALS: Trent's Zudio, Reliance's Yousta and Trends, Vishal Mega Mart, Style Union and Max Fashion, along with Meesho online. Unorganised local clothing shops remain its biggest competition in small towns.
parts.WATCH: V-Mart keeps opening stores in small towns. Watch how it competes with fast-growing Zudio and whether LimeRoad helps or drags results. It has also been cutting losses at LimeRoad and trying to improve sales per store.

quiz.prompt: Which value fashion chain in south India does V-Mart own?
Where is V-Mart's core customer base?
Which Tata-owned chain is a fast-growing rival to V-Mart?

companies.note_30w: V-Mart runs value fashion stores in smaller north and east Indian towns, owns south India's Unlimited, and battles Zudio and Vishal Mega Mart.

companies.name: Shoppers Stop

parts.SELLS: Shoppers Stop runs department stores selling fashion, beauty and accessories, along with the beauty chain SS Beauty and the value fashion format Intune. It is part of the K Raheja Corp group and sells brands such as Levi's and Clinique alongside its own labels.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin on what it sells, and private labels and beauty carry richer margins than bought-in brands. Its First Citizen loyalty programme drives repeat shopping from its best customers.
parts.SIZE: One of India's oldest and largest department store chains, present in most big cities. It was one of the first modern department store chains in India, opening its first store in Mumbai in 1991.
parts.RIVALS: Trent's Westside and Zudio, Lifestyle, Reliance Trends, Pantaloons and Central, with Nykaa competing in beauty. Online, Myntra, Ajio and Amazon compete for the same fashion and beauty shoppers.
parts.WATCH: The company is expanding Intune quickly in smaller cities and growing SS Beauty. Watch whether value fashion and beauty lift profits. Kavindra Mishra took over as CEO in 2023; watch for any leadership changes as his term comes up for renewal.

quiz.prompt: Which value fashion format does Shoppers Stop run?
What is Shoppers Stop's loyalty programme called?
Which group is Shoppers Stop part of?

companies.note_30w: Shoppers Stop, a K Raheja Corp company, runs department stores, SS Beauty and the Intune value format, competing with Westside, Lifestyle and Reliance Trends.

companies.name: Lifestyle International

parts.SELLS: Lifestyle International is the Indian arm of Dubai's Landmark Group. It runs Lifestyle department stores, Max Fashion value stores, Home Centre furniture stores and Easybuy, selling clothing, footwear, beauty and home goods.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin on what it sells. Max Fashion is its biggest business by stores and sales, with mostly own-label clothing, while Lifestyle stores sell both outside brands and private labels.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest fashion retailers, with Max among the biggest value fashion chains in the country. Lifestyle and Home Centre stores are found in malls across most large cities.
parts.RIVALS: Shoppers Stop, Trent's Westside and Zudio, Reliance Trends, Pantaloons and V-Mart. Home Centre competes with IKEA and Pepperfry. Myntra, Ajio and Amazon compete for its fashion shoppers online.
parts.WATCH: In 2025 Shital Mehta took a wider role as managing director and Sumit Chandna became CEO of Max Fashion. Watch Max's push into smaller cities. Also watch how its department stores hold up against value fashion chains.

quiz.prompt: Which value fashion chain is part of Lifestyle International?
Which group owns Lifestyle International?
Which furniture retailer competes with Home Centre?

companies.note_30w: Lifestyle International, Landmark Group's Indian arm, runs Lifestyle, Max Fashion, Home Centre and Easybuy. Max is its largest business, pushing into smaller cities.

companies.name: Vijay Sales

parts.SELLS: Vijay Sales is a family-run electronics retail chain selling phones, televisions, laptops, air conditioners and kitchen appliances from brands such as Apple, Samsung and LG. It sells through its stores, mostly in western and northern India, and its own website.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin on each product plus brand-funded promotions, extended warranties and financing tie-ups. Phones and large appliances bring most of its sales, with festive seasons the busiest.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest multi-brand electronics retail chains, strongest in Maharashtra and Gujarat. It started in Mumbai in the late 1960s and has grown into a chain spread across several states.
parts.RIVALS: Reliance Digital, Croma, Amazon and Flipkart, plus regional chains such as Pai International and Poorvika. Brand-owned stores from Apple and Samsung also compete for buyers of premium products.
parts.WATCH: Vijay Sales has been opening stores in new states and growing online. Watch how it competes with Reliance Digital and Croma. Also watch how quick-commerce apps that now deliver phones and gadgets affect store visits.

quiz.prompt: What does Vijay Sales mainly sell?
Which Tata-owned chain is a rival to Vijay Sales?
Which region is Vijay Sales strongest in?

companies.note_30w: Vijay Sales is a family-run electronics chain strong in Maharashtra and Gujarat, earning margins on phones and appliances while fighting Croma, Reliance Digital and online players.

companies.name: Malabar Gold & Diamonds

parts.SELLS: Malabar Gold & Diamonds sells gold, diamond and precious-stone jewellery through its showrooms in India, the Gulf and other countries, plus online. It is the flagship of the Malabar Group and is known for bridal jewellery and regional designs.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin and making charges on jewellery. Gold jewellery is most of its sales, while diamond and studded pieces earn richer margins. The Gulf and other overseas markets add a large share.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest jewellery retail chains and among India's biggest, with a wide international network. It started in Kozhikode in 1993.
parts.RIVALS: Tanishq, Kalyan Jewellers, Joyalukkas, Senco Gold and Reliance Jewels. In the Gulf it competes with local jewellers and other Indian chains, and in India also with thousands of family-run jewellery shops.
parts.WATCH: Malabar keeps opening showrooms in India and abroad. Watch how high gold prices affect demand and its plans for new markets. It has also been building jewellery manufacturing units in India.

quiz.prompt: Where is Malabar Gold & Diamonds headquartered?
What makes up most of Malabar's sales?
Which Titan jewellery brand competes with Malabar?

companies.note_30w: Malabar Gold & Diamonds, from Kozhikode, sells gold and diamond jewellery across India and abroad, earning margins and making charges, competing with Tanishq and Kalyan.

companies.name: Joyalukkas

parts.SELLS: Joyalukkas sells gold, diamond and platinum jewellery through showrooms in India and in the Gulf, the UK, Singapore and other markets. Founded by Joy Alukkas, it is known for bridal collections and large flagship stores.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin and making charges on jewellery, with gold being most of its sales. The Gulf is a major market alongside south India. Diamond and studded jewellery carry higher margins than plain gold.
parts.SIZE: One of the largest jewellery retailers from India, with a big presence among Indian communities overseas. Its showrooms span south India, the Gulf and several other countries.
parts.RIVALS: Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers, Tanishq and Senco Gold. In the Gulf it also competes with local jewellers, and in India with countless family-run jewellery shops.
parts.WATCH: Joyalukkas had filed for a public listing in India and later withdrew the plan. Watch its India expansion and the effect of gold prices on demand. The group also runs money exchange and fashion businesses.

quiz.prompt: Who founded Joyalukkas?
Which overseas region is a major market for Joyalukkas?
Which Kerala-based jeweller is a rival to Joyalukkas?

companies.note_30w: Joyalukkas, a Thrissur jeweller founded by Joy Alukkas, sells gold and diamond jewellery in India and the Gulf, competing with Malabar, Kalyan and Tanishq.

companies.name: Senco Gold & Diamonds

parts.SELLS: Senco Gold sells gold, diamond and silver jewellery under the Senco Gold & Diamonds brand, plus the lighter, everyday brand Everlite and the D'Signia diamond line. It is strongest in eastern India and listed on the stock exchanges in 2023.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin and making charges on jewellery. Gold jewellery brings most of its sales, while diamond pieces earn higher margins. It runs both company-owned and franchise showrooms.
parts.SIZE: One of the largest jewellery retailers in eastern India and among the top organised jewellers nationally. Its roots go back to a single family jewellery shop in Kolkata.
parts.RIVALS: Tanishq, Kalyan Jewellers, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, PC Jeweller and regional family jewellers. Online jewellers such as CaratLane and BlueStone compete for lightweight jewellery buyers.
parts.WATCH: Senco is expanding beyond eastern India, including through franchise stores. Watch demand at high gold prices and growth in its lightweight jewellery.

quiz.prompt: Which region is Senco Gold strongest in?
What is Senco's lighter, everyday jewellery brand?
How does Senco run some of its showrooms?

companies.note_30w: Senco Gold, a Kolkata jeweller listed in 2023, sells gold and diamond jewellery mainly in eastern India and is expanding nationally through owned and franchise showrooms.

companies.name: PC Jeweller

parts.SELLS: PC Jeweller sells gold and diamond jewellery through showrooms mainly in north India, along with some export business. It is known for wedding jewellery and diamond pieces.
parts.EARNS: It earns a margin and making charges on jewellery, with most sales coming from its domestic showrooms. Diamond jewellery has traditionally carried better margins than plain gold.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized national jeweller that was once among India's largest, and has shrunk after years of debt trouble. It was founded in 2005 by Balram Garg and grew quickly before running into trouble with lenders.
parts.RIVALS: Tanishq, Kalyan Jewellers, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Senco Gold and Reliance Jewels. Local family-run jewellers in Delhi and north India also compete hard for wedding buyers.
parts.WATCH: The company reached a settlement with its lender banks and has been working to cut debt and restart growth. Watch its debt repayment and showroom revival.

quiz.prompt: Which part of India is PC Jeweller mainly based in?
What has been PC Jeweller's main recent issue?
Which jeweller is a rival to PC Jeweller?

companies.note_30w: PC Jeweller is a Delhi jeweller selling gold and diamond jewellery mainly in north India, working through a settlement with banks to cut debt and revive growth.

companies.name: Mswipe

parts.SELLS: Mswipe provides card machines, Android point-of-sale devices, UPI QR codes and payment links that let small shops and merchants accept digital payments. It also offers business loans and tools to small merchants.
parts.EARNS: It earns a share of the fee on each card or digital transaction, rent on devices, and interest or fees from lending products offered to merchants with partners.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger independent merchant-payments companies, focused on small and mid-sized shops. Its merchants are spread across hundreds of cities and towns.
parts.RIVALS: Pine Labs, Paytm, PhonePe, BharatPe, Razorpay and bank-run card machines. Banks such as HDFC Bank and ICICI Bank also supply card machines to their own merchant customers.
parts.WATCH: Mswipe holds RBI approval to operate as a payment aggregator. Watch how it competes with free UPI soundboxes and grows merchant lending. Also watch RBI rules on payment aggregators and merchant fees.

quiz.prompt: Who are Mswipe's main customers?
Which company is a rival to Mswipe in card machines?
What does Mswipe earn from besides transaction fees?

companies.note_30w: Mswipe gives small merchants card machines, QR codes and loans, earning transaction fees and device rent while competing with Pine Labs, Paytm and PhonePe.

companies.name: Fino Payments Bank

parts.SELLS: Fino Payments Bank offers savings accounts, cash withdrawals, money transfers and bill payments, largely through small shops that act as banking points in villages and small towns. It also distributes loans and insurance for partners.
parts.EARNS: Most of its income comes from fees on transactions such as cash withdrawals, remittances and Aadhaar-based payments done through its merchant network, plus fees for distributing other firms' products.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest payments banks by merchant network, serving many customers in rural and semi-urban areas. Its reach comes mainly from its network of partner shops rather than branches.
parts.RIVALS: Airtel Payments Bank, India Post Payments Bank, Paytm and PhonePe, and banks' own business correspondents. Small finance banks also compete for the same customers.
parts.WATCH: In December 2025 the RBI gave in-principle approval for Fino to become a small finance bank, letting it lend. Its MD & CEO was arrested in a GST probe in 2026; the board later found him fit to continue.

quiz.prompt: How does Fino mainly reach customers?
options: Small shops acting as banking points

quiz.prompt: What approval did Fino receive from the RBI in December 2025?
options: To become a small finance bank

quiz.prompt: Which is a payments bank rival to Fino?

companies.note_30w: Fino Payments Bank offers basic banking through shop-based banking points in small towns, earning transaction fees, and has RBI in-principle approval to become a small finance bank.

companies.name: Equitas Small Finance Bank

parts.SELLS: Equitas Small Finance Bank offers savings and fixed-deposit accounts and lends to small businesses, home buyers, vehicle buyers and microfinance borrowers. It grew out of a microfinance company and is strongest in Tamil Nadu.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and what it pays depositors. Small-business loans against property and vehicle loans make up the biggest part of its book, ahead of microfinance.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger small finance banks, with a strong branch network in south India. It started as a microfinance company in 2007 and became a bank in 2016.
parts.RIVALS: AU Small Finance Bank, Ujjivan, Jana and Suryoday small finance banks, plus NBFCs such as Shriram Finance. Large private banks such as HDFC Bank also compete for its deposits.
parts.WATCH: The RBI approved P.N. Vasudevan's re-appointment as MD & CEO from July 2026, and the bank has announced plans to raise fresh capital. Watch stress in its microfinance loans.

quiz.prompt: Which state is Equitas strongest in?
What is the biggest part of Equitas's loan book?
Who leads Equitas as MD & CEO?

companies.note_30w: Equitas Small Finance Bank, based in Chennai, lends to small businesses, vehicle buyers and microfinance borrowers, funded by deposits, under re-appointed MD P.N. Vasudevan.

companies.name: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank

parts.SELLS: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank takes deposits and lends to low-income borrowers through group microfinance loans, plus affordable housing, small-business, vehicle and gold loans. It started as a microfinance lender.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and deposit costs. Microfinance is still its largest and highest-yielding segment, though the bank has been growing secured loans to reduce risk.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger small finance banks, with branches across many states. It was founded as a microfinance lender in 2005 and became a bank in 2017.
parts.RIVALS: Equitas, Jana, AU and Suryoday small finance banks, and microfinance lenders such as CreditAccess Grameen and Bandhan Bank. Large banks also compete for its depositors.
parts.WATCH: In April 2026 the RBI returned Ujjivan's application for a universal bank licence, asking it to diversify its loans more before reapplying. Watch the shift to secured lending.

quiz.prompt: What did the RBI do with Ujjivan's universal bank application in April 2026?
Which is Ujjivan's largest segment?
Which lender is a rival to Ujjivan?

companies.note_30w: Ujjivan Small Finance Bank lends mostly to low-income borrowers, led by microfinance, and must diversify further after the RBI returned its universal bank application.

companies.name: Jana Small Finance Bank

parts.SELLS: Jana Small Finance Bank offers deposits and loans to low-income and small-business customers, including microfinance, housing, gold and loans against property. It grew out of Janalakshmi Financial Services and listed in 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and deposit costs. Secured loans such as loans against property and housing are now a larger part of its book than unsecured microfinance.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger small finance banks by loans and deposits. Its branches are spread across many states, with a strong presence in south and west India.
parts.RIVALS: Ujjivan, Equitas, AU and Suryoday small finance banks, and lenders such as Bandhan Bank. NBFCs that lend against property also compete for its borrowers.
parts.WATCH: In October 2025 the RBI returned Jana's application to become a universal bank, and the bank has said it will evaluate applying again. Ajay Kanwal's current term runs to March 2027.

quiz.prompt: Which company did Jana Small Finance Bank grow out of?
What did the RBI do with Jana's universal bank application?
Which bank is a rival to Jana?

companies.note_30w: Jana Small Finance Bank, listed in 2024, has shifted towards secured loans and plans to reapply for a universal bank licence after an earlier return.

companies.name: Suryoday Small Finance Bank

parts.SELLS: Suryoday Small Finance Bank takes deposits and lends to low-income borrowers through microfinance, plus vehicle, housing and small-business loans. It is strongest in Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu and Odisha.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and deposit costs. Microfinance is its largest segment and earns high interest, but it also carries more credit risk.
parts.SIZE: A smaller small finance bank compared with leaders like AU and Equitas. It started as a microfinance lender in 2008 and became a bank in 2017.
parts.RIVALS: Ujjivan, Equitas, Jana and ESAF small finance banks, and microfinance lenders such as Spandana Sphoorty. Large banks also compete for its depositors.
parts.WATCH: Suryoday is growing secured loans to cut its reliance on microfinance. Its management has said it is in no hurry to become a universal bank. Also watch stress in microfinance loans.

quiz.prompt: What is Suryoday's largest segment?
Which state is a key market for Suryoday?
Which lender competes with Suryoday?

companies.note_30w: Suryoday Small Finance Bank lends mainly through microfinance, strongest in Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu, and is adding secured loans to reduce risk.

companies.name: Unity Small Finance Bank

parts.SELLS: Unity Small Finance Bank offers savings accounts, fixed deposits and loans to small businesses and individuals. It was set up in 2021 by Centrum and BharatPe to take over the failed Punjab and Maharashtra Co-operative (PMC) Bank.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and deposit costs. It lends through branches and through fintech partners, and is known for offering high fixed-deposit rates to attract savers.
parts.SIZE: A young, smaller small finance bank, built on PMC Bank's former branches. Its branches are mostly in Maharashtra, with a growing digital presence.
parts.RIVALS: Shivalik, Suryoday and Ujjivan small finance banks, plus co-operative banks and fintech lenders. Large banks also compete for its depositors.
parts.WATCH: Unity is still recovering money from PMC Bank's old bad loans. Watch its fintech partnerships and steps toward profitability and a possible listing. Also watch loan quality on fintech-sourced loans.

quiz.prompt: Which failed bank did Unity take over?
Which fintech co-promoted Unity?
How does Unity attract savers?

companies.note_30w: Unity Small Finance Bank, set up by Centrum and BharatPe to absorb failed PMC Bank, lends to small businesses and attracts savers with high deposit rates.

companies.name: Shivalik Small Finance Bank

parts.SELLS: Shivalik Small Finance Bank offers savings accounts, deposits and loans to small businesses and individuals, mainly in north India. It became the first urban co-operative bank to convert into a small finance bank, in 2021.
parts.EARNS: It earns the gap between interest on loans and deposit costs. Small-business and secured retail loans form its core, and it also partners with fintechs to offer accounts and credit.
parts.SIZE: A small small finance bank with branches mostly in Uttar Pradesh and nearby states. It is much smaller than leaders such as AU and Equitas.
parts.RIVALS: Unity, Suryoday and Ujjivan small finance banks, plus co-operative banks and regional lenders. Larger private and public sector banks also compete for its depositors.
parts.WATCH: Shivalik is growing its fintech partnerships and branch network. Watch how it scales while keeping loan quality steady. Also watch any plans to raise fresh capital or list.

quiz.prompt: What was Shivalik before it became a small finance bank?
Where are most of Shivalik's branches?
Which small finance bank is a rival to Shivalik?

companies.note_30w: Shivalik, the first urban co-operative bank to become a small finance bank, lends to small businesses in north India and works with fintech partners.

companies.name: Avanse Financial Services

parts.SELLS: Avanse lends to students for higher studies in India and abroad, and to schools and colleges for expansion. It also offers loans to small businesses. It is backed by Warburg Pincus.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest on loans. Education loans for students going abroad are its biggest business, while loans to education institutions add a second, smaller stream.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading education-focused lenders. It is among the biggest non-bank lenders for study abroad, alongside Credila, with a presence in many Indian cities.
parts.RIVALS: Credila, Auxilo, InCred and banks such as SBI and Bank of Baroda in education loans. Global lenders such as Prodigy Finance and MPower Financing also lend to Indian students.
parts.WATCH: Avanse filed papers for a public listing. Watch how changing visa rules in countries such as the US, Canada and the UK affect student loan demand. Also watch its growth in loans to schools and colleges.

quiz.prompt: What is Avanse's main business?
Which firm backs Avanse?
Which lender is a rival to Avanse?

companies.note_30w: Avanse, backed by Warburg Pincus, is an education-focused lender funding students abroad and institutions, with study-visa rules a key factor for demand.

companies.name: Credila Financial Services

parts.SELLS: Credila lends to Indian students for higher education, mostly for study abroad, covering tuition and living costs. Formerly HDFC Credila, it was sold by HDFC to a group led by EQT and ChrysCapital in 2024.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest on education loans. Loans for students going to the US, UK, Canada and other countries make up most of its book. Postgraduate students heading to top universities are its core borrowers.
parts.SIZE: India's largest education-loan-focused lender by loan book, per industry reports. It was India's first dedicated education loan company, started in 2006.
parts.RIVALS: Avanse, Auxilo, InCred, Prodigy Finance and banks such as SBI and Axis Bank. Global lenders such as MPower Financing also compete for Indian students.
parts.WATCH: Credila filed papers for a public listing. Watch visa and immigration rules abroad, which directly affect how many students borrow. Also watch competition from banks for top borrowers.

quiz.prompt: What was Credila's former name?
What makes up most of Credila's loans?
Which firms led the purchase of Credila?

companies.note_30w: Credila, formerly HDFC Credila and now owned by EQT and ChrysCapital, lends mostly to students studying abroad and depends heavily on foreign visa rules.

companies.name: Veritas Finance

parts.SELLS: Veritas Finance lends to small and micro businesses such as shops and workshops, mostly secured against property, plus used-vehicle and home loans. Its borrowers are often first-time customers in smaller towns.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest on loans. Small-business loans against property are its largest product and carry higher rates than bank loans. It also earns interest on used-vehicle and home loans.
parts.SIZE: A mid-sized NBFC focused on small businesses, strongest in south India. Its branches are mostly in Tamil Nadu, Karnataka and other southern states.
parts.RIVALS: Five-Star Business Finance, Aye Finance, SK Finance, Ugro Capital and small finance banks. Banks and local moneylenders also compete for small-business borrowers.
parts.WATCH: Veritas has been expanding its branches beyond south India. Watch loan quality among small businesses and any listing plans. Also watch funding costs, since it borrows from banks.

quiz.prompt: Who are Veritas Finance's main borrowers?
What is Veritas's largest loan product?
options: Loans against property for small businesses

quiz.prompt: Which lender competes with Veritas?

companies.note_30w: Veritas Finance, a Chennai NBFC, lends to small and micro businesses mostly against property, expanding from south India into new regions.

companies.name: SK Finance

parts.SELLS: SK Finance lends for commercial vehicles, tractors, cars and two-wheelers, and gives small-business loans, mostly in Rajasthan and nearby states. It is backed by private equity firms including TPG and Norwest.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest on loans. Vehicle loans, especially for used commercial vehicles and tractors, are its largest segment. Small-business loans add a second, smaller stream.
parts.SIZE: One of the larger vehicle-finance NBFCs in Rajasthan and north-west India. Most of its branches are in Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh and Gujarat.
parts.RIVALS: Shriram Finance, Mahindra Finance, Cholamandalam, AU Small Finance Bank and Veritas Finance. Banks also compete for vehicle buyers with better credit records.
parts.WATCH: SK Finance received approval for a public listing but has not listed. Watch its expansion into new states and loan quality. Also watch rural demand for tractors and commercial vehicles.

quiz.prompt: Which state is SK Finance's home market?
What is SK Finance's largest segment?
Which vehicle financier competes with SK Finance?

companies.note_30w: SK Finance, a Jaipur NBFC, lends mainly for vehicles and tractors in Rajasthan and nearby states, competing with Shriram and Mahindra Finance.

companies.name: Satin Creditcare Network

parts.SELLS: Satin Creditcare gives small group loans to rural women for income-generating activities, mostly in north and east India. Through subsidiaries it also offers housing loans and small-business loans.
parts.EARNS: It earns interest on loans. Microfinance is by far its largest business, while the housing and small-business subsidiaries are smaller. Borrowers usually repay in small, regular instalments collected at group meetings.
